title: Never add "cv-ats" to identity.contact.publishPhoneOn: that surface is the public /cv HTML page, not only the PDF
body: `publishPhoneOn` (content/data/content.*.json, enforced by rule 8 in content/schema/resolve-view.ts) lists the surfaces allowed to emit the phone. It is `[]` today on purpose. It is tempting to add `cv-ats` so the downloaded PDF carries a phone number, but the PDF and the `/cv` + `/en/cv` HTML pages render the SAME surface (the PDF is printed from that page by functions/_handler.ts), and the landing's #cv section also uses cv-ats. Adding it once put the phone on the open web. If a phone ever has to reach a recruiter, it needs a surface that is not served as a public page; do not reuse cv-ats. Same reasoning applies to `streetAddress`.
not_derivable: The schema lets any Surface be listed; nothing in code says cv-ats was tried there and leaked the phone onto the public HTML page.

evidence.summary: Rule 8: phone only leaves when publishPhoneOn includes the surface.
